title: No test opens the check-in poster page
what: The web page a member reaches by scanning the gym's check-in poster has no automated test. Nothing checks its words for Android with the app, without the app, an iPhone, a wrong poster or no internet, or that it never shows a member's name.
expected: A test opens the poster page as each kind of phone and checks what it says, like the invite page test already does.
fix_line: Add a page test for the check-in poster like the invite-link one

title: The invite link page's key words and its WhatsApp preview are never checked
what: Tests check the invite page's heading and buttons, but not 'invites you to the MettleUp app', the 'First, get the MettleUp app' card, the older-app try, the 'Gym not found' and 'Couldn't reach the gym' states, or the preview title and line WhatsApp shows. The preview test replaces the part that writes the title with one that does nothing, so a wrong or leaking preview would pass.
expected: Tests read the page's words in each state and the preview title and description the server writes.
fix_line: Check the invite page states and the preview text in the existing invite tests

title: No test checks the gym-server relay's no-run safety headers
what: The relay adds two safety headers so a gym-server answer can never run as a page on the admin app address, where the desks' saved keys live. No test checks either header, so removing them would pass every test.
expected: The relay test asserts both safety headers on every answer.
fix_line: Assert the two safety headers in the relay test

title: No test checks the admin app moves to a new version and drops the old files
what: The offline keeper is meant to show the newest version when online and remove old files after a deploy. No test runs a second deploy against it, so a desk stuck on yesterday's buttons, or a blank page from a dropped file, would pass. The skip-list test also never checks the check-in page is kept out of the device copy.
expected: A test installs one version, deploys another, and checks the new one shows online and offline with no old file left; the skip test includes the check-in page.
fix_line: Add a two-version test of the offline keeper

title: No test checks a shared desk computer keeps no gym copy after sign-out
what: Tests sign out of a device and see the Sign in button, but none then goes offline or reloads to check the previous person's members and payments cannot be read.
expected: After sign-out, a test reloads offline and finds no gym data on screen or in the device copy.
fix_line: Extend the sign-out test to reload offline and check nothing is left

title: The desk's payment-link messages are never checked on screen
what: The collect sheet's 'Making the link...', the camera line, the WhatsApp payment message, 'Sent. They see it under My membership...', the missing-mobile message, 'No internet. Try again.' and the 'paid online but the receipt could not be made' card have no test on screen. The server refusal of a Rs 0 or tiny amount also has no test.
expected: The payment screen test checks each of these lines, and a server test sends a zero amount and gets the refusal.
fix_line: Add these lines and a zero-amount call to the payment tests

title: The member's pay card words are never checked
what: The member test checks the amount, failed and run-out lines, but not 'Pay your gym', the UPI scan line, the 'Pay by UPI app' button, 'Paid. The gym can see it.', 'Online payment is not set up at this gym yet. Pay at the desk.' or the test-mode line.
expected: The member pay test checks every line the card and the order payment show.
fix_line: Assert the remaining pay card words in the member pay test

title: No test keeps the delete-account page's backup promise in step with the privacy notice
what: The delete-account page promises backup copies go within 7 days, and the privacy notice says the same in its own words. No test reads either line, so one could change and the two pages would disagree.
expected: A test checks the backup line on the delete-account page matches the privacy notice.
fix_line: Add a line check to the legal pages test

title: No test checks an unknown /api address answers 'Not found'
what: The server answers 404 'Not found' for an /api address it does not know, so the admin app page is never served there. No test asks for such an address.
expected: The address test asks for a made-up /api address and gets 404 'Not found'.
fix_line: Add one made-up /api address to the address test
